# J119 exact retired-facet family and a nonsimple common-apex control

This is a complete recovery capsule for four distinct rational own211/weak000/primitive000 bodies and one deliberately preserved nonwinner. It depends on the complete exact115.cpp source in [internal-source-reference] (11038 bytes, SHA d7fd1244c086a0c5354844cca3453c42b26ed31a55b89720aa9e3987f0a06736). Select that material as well for an executable successor. No originating sandbox is needed. Scientific parent is the completely read figure-0593, but its literal input is not required to reconstruct these fully specified successors.

Save the following complete code, including its final newline, as recover_retired119.py: 13699 bytes, SHA bd481c34afb1b0e483eea1747b2aa23ddc6bfa89681e023d1efa83805ef8e37f. Compile and run the commands in its docstring. It checks every input, exact audit output and terminal log against all 15 expected byte counts and SHA values. The auditor rebuilds the true hull, maximal facets and edges, actual uniform mass, full strict/additional-weak census and all positive P/Q bars without a numerical floor. This is an executed exact engine, not a claim of two independent implementations.

J119_RETIRED79_G8 is154/231/79,C462,Q in(200438320427978,200438320427979)/10^15. RETIRED74_G8 and G7 are144/216/74,C432 with Q respectively in(270475062081764,270475062081765)/10^15 and(270475061041586,270475061041587)/10^15. RETIRED73_G8 is142/213/73,C426,Q in(301840467082304,301840467082305)/10^15. All four are own211/weak000/primitive000,P[]. G7 simplifies centroid numerator/denominator bit lengths from20129/20134 to17230/17235. They trade greater Q depth for real support-count reserve, not monotone persistence improvement.

The double-apex body has106 submitted supports but78 active maximal facets,122 vertices,198 true edges,C396. One vertex has degree33 and the other121 have degree3. Its own strict class is(40,25,63),weak000,primitive000; all24 positive P and39 positive Q are returned. It is NOT110,211 or222. The32 added rows are exact affine combinations of three old incident support rows, preserving their common apex. Independent rounding of those rows is not the same object. Reference-point experiments motivating these rows are numerical only; actual mass and census here are exact.
